notes.title: Upcoming Price Change
notes.content:
Starting on March 1st 2024, the price of the game will be reduced to $0. This change is permanent, the game will remain free indefinitely.

No changes will be made to the gameplay. No ads and no micro-transactions. The game will be free-to-play with full feature completeness.

This change is being made to encourage more people to play the game. I thank everyone who purchased the game and supported it's release.

notes.title: Free Demo Released!
notes.content:
A little late here but I finally released a free downloadable demo for Slime Slam. The demo includes only Endless Mode, but all the customization features are present and there is no time limit on play. Hopefully this will get people to try the game out and see if they like it before purchasing. 

The demo is also playable with 2 players, though Versus mode is locked, the side-by-side feature of Endless mode is present.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
This is a small patch aimed at fixing incompatibility issues with recent Windows updates. File structure has changed a little as well as the main exe file's names. Updating should work smoothly but if the game fails to launch, try the "verify game files" button in the "properties/local files" by right clicking the game in the steam library list. 

If you have experienced odd slow downs, lower than 60 frames per second or other sync issues, this should fix that problem.

No new content was added by this patch.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Patch changes the following:
- Cuts the character limit for names appearing in the leaderboards. 
- Also hides slimes when the game is paused.

There is still an issue with non-latin player names not appearing in the leaderboards correctly. I'm looking into the issue for now but there doesn't seem to be an easy solution.
